name: session-walkthrough
description: Live, self-driven walkthrough tours of session changes in the running browser, plus recorded walkthrough bundles on request: scoped source fingerprints, a validated provenance manifest and a portable HTML page. Read-mostly; never approval, upload, save or Git authority.

interface.shortDescription: Walk users through session changes with a live in-browser tour.
interface.longDescription: Run a live, self-driven overlay tour of a session's changes in the already-running managed browser: each step highlights a changed element and quotes the request line it covers. On explicit request, validate provenance manifests, render portable local HTML reports and record source scope. Capture tooling, workspace integration and platform pilots for the recorded bundle remain pending.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through the changes from this session.
Review a recorded walkthrough manifest against its contracts.
